restoration_note: The teaching describes the threefold-prayer/threefold-sending arc: Mother of Life intercedes for the First Man → Living Spirit raises him and gives expanse → Five intercede → Third Ambassador chooses out the Living Soul → Jesus the Radiance completes the purpose-of-heart of the elements. Restorations were strongly constrained where the editor's proposals were corroborated by (a) the standing technical lexicon (ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ, ⲡⲡⲣ̄ⲃⲉ, ⲣⲉϩϯⲟⲩⲁⲥⲧⲛ̄, ⲡⲱⲕ ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ, ϯⲩⲭⲏ ⲉⲧⲁⲛⲍ̄), (b) line-spanning continuations of words (ⲁⲣⲉⲧϥ̄, ⲡⲫⲟⲥⲥⲁ, ⲡⲁⲓⲁⲃⲟⲗⲟⲥ, ⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲙ̄ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ, ⲡⲭⲓⲥⲉ), and (c) the fixed prayer-formula sequence (ⲧⲱⲃⲍ̄ — ⲁⲓⲧⲓ — ⲥⲙⲁⲙⲉ — ϯⲉⲁⲩ — ⲝⲓ). The lower portion of the chapter (lines ch.115.140 onward) is heavily abraded; gaps of 8–35 chars with little surrounding anchor were marked unrestorable rather than smoothed over. A handful of partially-constrained gaps were filled at moderate or low confidence where context (e.g. ⲡⲙⲧⲁⲛ ⲙⲛ̄ ⲡⲣⲉϣⲉ at {54}, the standard ⲡⲓϣⲁⲣⲡ ⲛ̄ⲣⲱⲙⲉ at {193}, the ⲡⲣⲉⲥⲃⲉⲩⲧⲏⲥ ending at {187}) gave a strong but not absolute pattern.
